text:
Riley: Launch checklist for Beacon tenant at 09:00 PT. Short, customer-facing runbook: prefill, cache, batch, streaming, handoff, and a tiny feedback capture flow. Who can own post-48h notes?

Sam: I can take prefill knobs. Proposed: warm=2 targeted hits, seed prompts=['welcome','usage-examples'], static_ttl=5h, session_ttl=12m.

Riley: Batch defaults: max_batch=7, batch_timeout=75ms, latency_SLO_p95=140ms. If p95 breaches -> reduce max_batch to 4 for 30m.

Dee: SRE runes: if cold-start surge > 6 rps per instance for 90s, route new traffic to warm pool and mark tenant status="partial". Create alert: error_rate > 3% over 2m -> escalate.

Ivy: Cost control: start on quantized-small profile for 24h. If quality score (sampled evals) >= 0.88 after 24h, trial bump to standard model for quality validation.

Luca: Renewal signal: flag CSM if user-reported interruptions or >15% truncated responses in first 72h. Add to weekly renewal queue.

Riley: Feedback capture: in-app micro-survey after first 20 interactions: two quick taps (setup: easy/ok/hard, latency: ok/not-ok) + optional text. Results auto-save to Airtable form https://airtable.com/shrBeaconFB and tag tenant.

Sam: Prefill sample curl: 

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"tenant_id":"beacon","prompts":["welcome","howto"],"warm":2}'
```

Dee: If token lengths spike, enforce per-tenant caps: max_tokens=512, per_min=70. Alert if token_util > 115% for 5m -> page oncall.

Ivy: Streaming UX: emit keepalive every 300ms of silence; client should show partial output and be idempotent for repeated chunks. Also set fallback to non-streaming chunked responses if client fails to ack.

Riley: CSM handoff checklist: prefill success >= 92%, cache_ttls set, batch p95 < 140ms, feedback modal scheduled, 72h renewal-risk evaluated.

Luca: I'll run the 48h retro and post notes to #customer-success. :white_check_mark:

OpsBot: Reminder set by @OpsBot for 48h retro at 1801238167.

Riley: Also add a small UX banner for graceful-degrade when falling back to smaller model: one sentence + support link.

Sam: Noted. Will add banner copy to onboarding kit.
